And they left my Griffon completely bald.

The service is sometimes excellent and sometimes leaves much to be desired... it all depends on the doctor you get. A while ago, I took my dog ​​in because he looked sick, and they refused to see him because "their doctor wasn't there." I mean, you take your pet for a checkup because you want them to be seen, it doesn't matter who examines them, just that they're seen quickly. So they gave me an appointment for when the doctor was available... unfortunately, my dog ​​didn't make it to his appointment. He passed away at home after a lot of suffering. It was so sudden that another doctor didn't even have time to examine him. 😓 I hope they take these criticisms into account and use them to improve their service because until recently, it was one of the best veterinary clinics in the area.
Excellent service, very professional.

They don't display their prices, and they take advantage of the love you have for your pet. In just two weeks, they raised the consultation fee three times without even mentioning it. During consultations, they show zero empathy for the pets, going in and out of the office without regard for the fact that slamming doors or other loud noises make the kittens nervous. One of the veterinarians gave us false information, instilling fear about possible illnesses. In the end, they see pets as nothing more than dollar signs.

I truly don't know how to thank this veterinarian enough. They've treated my two cats and my dog. My dog ​​had a severe digestive problem, and my cat had bladder issues. They ALWAYS provide excellent care and diagnoses. The price is reasonable, very fair. And although I've been to other veterinarians, I always come back here because they're the only ones who have helped my pets recover.
I'm very critical of veterinary care and prices, and this place has always exceeded my expectations. I've been coming here for four years, and thank you so much for everything you do for my pets.

I've been taking my dog ​​here for almost two years now, and the diagnoses are accurate. They always treat my dog ​​with great care and explain everything we need to know about her diagnosis and treatment. I highly recommend them.

Excellent team! They saved my kitten; he fell from a sixth-floor window, and they caught him. They're professional and have great equipment for diagnosis and treatment. I'm eternally grateful to them. 🤗 …
I've had several appointments, the vet treated my cat very well, we're still having check-ups for several things, but it's been good care so far.

I've known the clinic for over 10 years and I've always taken my dogs there. They've been treated by different doctors, including Doca Benet himself, and they've all been professional. I don't think it's a clinic that's just trying to make money; it's always given me a lot of confidence and peace of mind to take them there.

I don't know why they've been getting such bad reviews lately. The truth is, I've taken all my dogs there and everything has been perfect. They even diagnosed my Chihuahua with pyometra, and no one else wanted to operate, but they did it there and everything went very well. So I highly recommend them. Dr. Gerardo is the best!

I took my dog ​​to the clinic because she stopped eating, and they gave me a fatalistic diagnosis. They refused to operate, saying it wasn't a 24-hour clinic, and told me to go to a veterinary hospital. Since I'd lived in Pachuca my whole life, I called my trusted veterinarian, who told me to bring my dog ​​in. He examined her and operated. He gave her back to me two hours later with instructions for home care. She recovered. Honestly, this veterinary clinic has terrible doctors who just want to rip you off.
Amazing service, expert veterinarians, and reasonable prices!
I really liked the service and the expertise they demonstrated when analyzing my pet's condition; the prices are very affordable for the quality of care.
Excellent service
Excellent service, 100% recommended, they treat your pets wonderfully, professional veterinarians

I'd had good experiences with basic checkups, but this time I took my older cat for routine tests to check his health. Dr. Gerardo diagnosed him with advanced kidney failure with a single blood test, and the treatment was to give him a daily pill (to a cat!) for life, as well as a significant subcutaneous injection of fluid once a week. I took him for the procedure once, and they create a hump of fluid that they gradually absorb, but he even dared to recommend that I shave him because they would have to shave him every time he had the procedure done... I didn't feel good at all about the diagnosis and the quality of life my cat would have, even though he seemed healthy to me... I sought a second medical opinion, and with just one simple urine test, they ruled out kidney failure! Because it turns out that only these tests can provide a more in-depth understanding of kidney function. My cat is healthy! And of course, he's not terminally ill.

I can't believe this irresponsible diagnosis and the doctor's incredibly unfriendly treatment. Now, months later, my cat's health would likely be very different due to the stress of weekly vet visits for injections and shaving... disastrous interpretations and management.

The vet did things half-heartedly; she didn't examine my dog ​​properly and gave me a wrong diagnosis. This resulted in my dog ​​being hospitalized in serious condition with pancreatitis, and all she told me was back pain. Terrible... Well, three days later, my dog ​​died due to delayed treatment. I recommend this vet go back to her classes, but this time in person, because it's clear she finished her studies during the pandemic.
NOT RECOMMENDED AT ALL. ONE OF MY DOGS IS VERY SICK BECAUSE THEY ONLY GAVE HIM A SUPERFICIAL EXAM. I HAD TO TAKE HIM TO A REAL VET.

Terrible place! I took my dog ​​there for a checkup for constipation. They barely examined him and never even checked his vital signs with a stethoscope until I told the doctor! Today my dog ​​is in serious condition with pancreatitis at a veterinary clinic. If you're responsible, don't go to this place; they're all about making money.
Excellent service and very professional, they make us feel like our pets are part of their family.
The receptionist was rude. Expensive and bad service. Don't go, save yourself the trouble. They're very indifferent to the animals. They don't care. They see them as just another number, period.
Terrible service. I don't recommend taking their dogs there for emergency care (if I hadn't taken mine somewhere else, something serious could have happened). The "doctors" had a terrible attitude.
The best care and follow-up for my pet 😺 They are very kind …

I love how they've taken care of my little Amy.

Dr. Miriam provides outstanding care, explains everything in detail, and inspires a lot of confidence. Similarly, Dr. Gustavo's experience is evident. 100% recommended. I am very grateful for all the care my dog ​​received and the excellent teamwork.

Excellent service, fair prices. Very good customer service, among the best in the area.
The doctors are excellent; they don't leave you with any unanswered questions—very professional.
It's the go-to place for all my cats. Dr. Itzel is dedicated and very patient. The prices are reasonable.

I've been going there for several years, and I can say that there are different levels of doctors. Dr. Gustavo has retired, but he was always kind, accurate in his diagnoses, and empathetic with pets. His office was always full of people waiting for him.

Dr. Gerardo is also very good, kind to dogs and their owners, and takes the time to ask insightful questions and think ahead when planning treatment.

There's a new doctor I haven't met who I've heard has a lot of experience.

I wouldn't recommend the other doctors. If it's a minor issue, or it's your first time, they treat you well. But if it's something they don't understand, they just prescribe whatever and that's it. Some treat the animal with disdain, or even make immature comments about the pet among themselves.

In our case, due to a lack of accuracy in the diagnosis, the process dragged on and became difficult and unpleasant for my dog. I overheard one of the doctors who had previously misdiagnosed him looking at him and laughing at him, making comments to the staff. It was awful. Fortunately, another doctor saw us, but it was still completely unnecessary.

Being a veterinarian isn't all about hugging and kissing dogs all day; obviously, there are unpleasant things to do, and it's essential to treat patients with dignity, or find another profession.

1. I took a kitten that had been hit by a car and they refused to treat it.

2. I bought tick tablets for $310. I told the girl it was just one tablet and she said yes, that there was one. I got home, put on my glasses, and realized the box said three. Honestly, that's ridiculous. Either they teach them to steal, or the doctor has a thief.

Imagine taking your cat to be spayed and they find out she had a heart attack during the surgery. This doesn't even happen at spay/neuter clinics with minimal resources, and they charge a fortune, with inexperienced veterinarians. And it's not the first time they've done something like this. She didn't just die, they killed her.

Three days ago, I took my kitten to a vet named Gyna. She immediately put her under to run tests, made three needle pricks, and couldn't find a vein. Then it turns out she needed surgery, and they gave her too much anesthesia. Apparently, she suffered respiratory arrest, and they handed her back to me dead. And then they immediately offered cremation services. I wouldn't call them doctors; they're unempathetic people with dollar signs written all over their faces. Completely unprofessional. They did the same thing to a friend's dog. It's not right.
the absolute WORST place to take you pet, they have killed many pets! Just read the reviews!!!!

How is it possible that they draw two tubes of blood from a kitten that weighs less than 2 kg? And when she dies from respiratory arrest due to stress, the first thing they do is offer their funeral services. Shameful. Total negligence. Take responsibility for Powder.

Everything is horrible; they make you spend money. The negligence is absurd, to the point of making you want to leave your pets alone. And shamelessly, after all the mess they make, they keep trying to squeeze money out of you by offering funeral services, even though they are responsible for your pet's death. This situation is unacceptable.

Of all the clinics and veterinarians we've visited, this place stands out for the professionalism and dedication of its entire staff, from reception to veterinarians and surgeons. This is not a profit-driven place; on the contrary, the animals are treated with the utmost compassion. The cost of surgery is completely reasonable, and it's the first time we've felt truly at ease leaving our pet in such good hands—that's priceless. Highly recommended.
